        {"type": "precedence", "expression": "x8 <= x5", "description": "T8 (statistical analysis) requires T5 (multi-physics coupling solver). Since T5 requires T2, T8 transitively requires T2."}
    ]
    num_variables = len(resources)

    # Construct the QUBO
    qbo_vars = {}
    for i, res in enumerate(resources):
        qbo_vars[res["variable"]] = 0  # Initialize all variables to 0

    qbo_cols = []

    # Create the QUBO
    qp = QuadraticProgram(rows=len(qbo_rows), cols=num_variables)
    qp.objective = qbo_rows
    qp.constraints = qp.add_constraints(qbo_rows, [0] * len(qbo_rows))

    # Solve the QUBO
    optimizer = SLSQP()  # or COBYLA()
    result = optimizer.minimize(qp)

    # Extract the solution
    selected_tasks = [i + 1 for i, x in enumerate(result.x) if x > 0.5]
    total_cpu_hours = sum(resources[i]["cpu_hours"] for i in selected_tasks)

        "runtime": runtime,
        "evaluation_cost": evaluation_cost,
        "achieved_value": achieved_value,
        "selected_tasks": selected_tasks,
        "total_cpu_hours": total_cpu_hours
